[[File:Magic Dart icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Magic Dart''' is an offensive spell that requires 50 [[Magic]] and 55 [[Slayer]] to cast. The spell '''requires''' a [[slayer's staff]], [[slayer's staff (e)]], [[Staff of the Dead|staff of the dead]], [[toxic staff of the dead]], [[staff of light]] or [[staff of balance]] to be wielded in order to cast it. All these staves can [[autocast]] the spell.

Magic Dart is the only option for players who wish to slay [[Turoth]] or [[Kurasks]] using [[Magic]].

If cast using a [[Slayer's staff (e)]], the projectile becomes a white colour instead of green.

==Maximum hit==
The maximum hit of Magic Dart is <math>\lfloor MagicLevel \times \frac{1}{10} \rfloor + 10</math>. For example, at 60 Magic the max hit would be 16. The spell hits a maximum of 19 at 90+ Magic, or 20 if [[Temporary skill boost|boosted]] above 99.

If the [[Slayer's staff (e)]] is used while [[Slayer task|on task]], its max hit is even higher; its new formula is <math>\lfloor MagicLevel \times \frac{1}{6} \rfloor + 13</math>. Each cast consumes one charge from the slayer's staff (e) if the spell hits. Additional maximum hit values for the Slayer's staff (e) can be found [[Slayer's staff (e)|here]].

==Cost==
{{Spell cost table
|Rune1 = death
|Rune1num = 1
|Rune2 = mind
|Rune2num = 4
|no_staff = 2
}}
When cast with the [[Slayer's staff (e)]] against an assigned Slayer monster, the cost of a charge of the [[Slayer's enchantment]] adds a little less than {{coins|{{#expr: ceil( {{GEP|Slayer's enchantment|1 / 2500}} ) }}|2}}, increasing the total to {{coins|{{#expr: ceil( {{GEP|Slayer's enchantment|1 / 2500}} + {{GEP|Mind rune|4}} + {{GEP|Death rune}} ) }}|2}}. Therefore, it is always recommended to use an enchanted Slayer's staff instead of a regular Slayer's staff, when fighting a slayer monster with Magic Dart.

==Trivia==
*In ''RuneScape 3'', the spell was renamed to Slayer Dart in the {{RSL|Evolution of Combat}} update. Although the spell has never been called that in ''Old School RuneScape'', a few developer blogs in the early days of ''Old School'' referred to the spell as Slayer Dart.
*Magic Dart is currently the only combat spell in the standard spellbook that does not require any elemental runes.
*Magic Dart is one of the few magic attacks and the only spell whose max hit increases with the player's Magic level. The others are the spells used by [[Powered staff|powered staves]] (such as the [[trident of the seas]]), and the [[salamanders]]' magic attacks.
*Although an enchanted slayer's staff turns the projectile white, splashed spells still retain their green colour.
